definitions.gloss: green beans, string beans, snap beans
definitions.explanation: A common vegetable in Japanese cuisine, often used in side dishes and stir-fries.

examples.japanese: インゲン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
インゲン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胡麻和|ごまあ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made green beans with sesame dressing.

examples.japanese: インゲン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧。
examples.english: Remove the strings from green beans before cooking.

notes:
インゲン is short for インゲン{豆|まめ} (string beans/green beans). Named after the monk {隠元|いんげん} who is said to have brought them from China in the 17th century.

WRITING:
Usually written in katakana. The kanji form {隠元|いんげん} exists but is rarely used for the vegetable.

COMMON DISHES:
- インゲン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胡麻和|ごまあ}え: green beans with sesame dressing
- {肉巻|にくま}きインゲン: meat-wrapped green beans
- インゲン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: green bean tempura
- インゲン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered green beans

PREPARATION:
Before cooking, the ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (strings) are typically removed by snapping the ends. Common cooking methods include ⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (boiling) and ⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ (stir-frying).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧: edamame (soybeans)
- ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧: beans (general)
